title: claude-broker base finding note
description: Durable team knowledge about code outside the poster's ownership. Lives on <ns>-notes (prune-exempt). Mirrors schemas/notes.json minus the namespace-specific closure.

from.description: Worker or orchestrator that posted it.

to.description: Worker it concerns, or '*' for the whole team.

subject.description: Headline readable in the summary projection (cb caps it at 120 via extension).

summary.description: One or two sentences: the claim (finding) or the choice and its reason (decision).

scope.description: Files, directories or subsystems the note is about. Array preferred; a bare string is tolerated (41 in the wild).

evidence.description: How it was established: command + output tail, sha, message id.

confidence.description: 'confirmed' (default) or 'suspected'; cb restricts to that enum via extension.

task_id.description: Task during which the note was made, if any.
